en.headline: Kelvin Kong appointed head of police National Security Department
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee named the long-serving officer deputy commissioner for national security, succeeding Andrew Kan who began pre-retirement leave on Tuesday.
body: Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu on Tuesday appointed Kelvin Kong Hok-lai as head of the Hong Kong Police Force's department for safeguarding national security, succeeding Andrew Kan Kai-yan.

The appointment, made under Article 16(2) of the national security law, took effect immediately after Kong took the oath of office. Kong, previously director of national security, has served with the force for three decades and has worked in the National Security Department since the law came into force.

Lee said Kong had demonstrated outstanding performance, exemplary commitment and exceptional leadership, and remained resolute in safeguarding national security. Kan began pre-retirement leave on the same day.

zh.headline: 江學禮獲任命為警務處維護國家安全部門負責人
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超任命江學禮接替已開始預休的簡啟恩，任命即日生效，江學禮同日宣誓就任。
body: 行政長官李家超周二任命江學禮為警務處維護國家安全部門負責人，接替已開始預休的警務處副處長（國家安全）簡啟恩。
任命按《香港國安法》第十六條第二款作出，即日生效，江學禮同日宣誓就任。江學禮此前出任國安處處長，在警隊服務30年，自國安法實施以來一直服務於國家安全處。
李家超表示，江學禮表現卓越、克盡厥職，具備出色領導才能，展現高度國家安全意識，意志堅定、無畏無懼。簡啟恩同日開始預休。
